name: Cognoscere / Lumira
currentPhase: Product validation, OKF contracts and future authenticated service architecture

relationship.cognoscere: The educational intelligence, pedagogical knowledge and competency structure.
relationship.lumira: The social and educational web platform through which students, teachers and schools interact with Cognoscere.

problem: Learning platforms often mix content, scores, social activity and competition without preserving the meaning or provenance of each domain.
solution: A competency-oriented educational platform connecting courses, BNCC skills, traceable materials, open activities, communities, schools and competitions while separating public content from protected pedagogical intelligence.

domains.name: Competency progression
domains.rule: Changes through quizzes and pedagogical evidence; social reputation and leaderboards do not directly alter competency.

domains.name: Social reputation
domains.rule: Represents contributions in communities and profiles; it remains distinct from learning level.

domains.name: School competition
domains.rule: Represents performance within a specific challenge; teacher-confirmed evidence may separately affect competency.

capabilities: Public product landing and enrolment journey
Courses, cycles, axes and continuous learning materials
BNCC provenance and visible source relationships
School challenges, submissions, rubrics and leaderboards
Responsive desktop and mobile social surfaces
implemented: Public OKF manifest and artifact client
Catalogue, course, axis and material navigation
Local demonstrative pre-analysis of open responses
Responsive campus, profile, forum, competition and account surfaces
planned: Protected model analysis with human confirmation
Moderation, reporting, blocking and audit trails
evidence: Validated mobile navigation and social drawer
Traceable course, material, skill and provenance relationships
